# AGENTS.md instructions for /Users/reorx/Code/tenderbuddy

<INSTRUCTIONS>
Your job is to develop the MVP for tenderbuddy, an Agentic AI system that analyzes tender documents
and generates corresponding bid documents.

The project has been initialized with TypeScript setup, Biome linter, and Tailwind CSS.
Postgresql is running and you have all the CLI to interact with it,


## Tech stack

- language: nodejs, typescript, pnpm
- web framework: React Router v7 (Framework Mode)
- css: tailwindcss v4
- uikit: shadcn
- orm: [drizzle](https://orm.drizzle.team/docs/overview)
- auth: [better-auth](https://www.better-auth.com/docs/introduction)
- database: postgresql
- workflow orchestration: inngest
- agent: openai sdk
- HTTP fetch state management: `@tanstack/react-query`
- object storage: minio
- knowledge base: dify


## Project Hierarchy

this is a pnpm workspace project, the project hierarchy is as follows:

- `app/`: React Router full stack application, use `@/*` as the alias for `app/src/*` path in imports
- `packages/core/`: core shared library, package name `@tbd/core`, no alias, just use relative path in imports


## Commands

### DB migration

First cd to `packages/core` directory, then run:
```bash
# generate migration file
pnpm db:generate

# migrate the database
pnpm db:migrate
```

## Knowledge Base UI Architecture

KB pages (`app/src/routes/knowledge/`) share a set of reusable components in `app/src/components/kb/`:

- **KbPageLayout** — pure presentation component with category sidebar, file grid, pagination, search, and category CRUD. Receives all data (categories, entries, pagination) as props from route loaders. Used by legal, product, and bidder-info pages. Personnel page has its own layout. All filterable/pageable state lives in URL search params (`category`, `search`, `page`, `pageSize`, `fileType`), managed via `useSearchParams`. Post-mutation refresh uses `useRevalidator`. Loading overlay via `useNavigation`.
- **loadKbPageData()** (`app/src/units/kb/load-kb-page-data.ts`) — shared loader helper called by KB route loaders. Initializes collection, fetches categories + entries server-side, resolves selected category from URL slug (falls back to first visible), validates pagination params. Accepts optional `categoryFilterFn`.
- **GenericEntryDrawer** — configurable entry drawer with name + file upload + optional extension fields (via render prop) + zod schema validation. Supports edit mode via `entryId` prop (loads existing files from backend).
- **DrawerShell** — lightweight shell (Sheet + header + footer) used by all drawers for consistent appearance.
- **FileCard** — file card component for the grid display. Shows image thumbnail (data URL from `kb_file.thumbnail`), text preview (`kb_file.text_preview`), or file-type icon as fallback. Small file-type icon always shown next to file name.
- **FormField** — shared form field wrapper used by specialized drawers.

Three specialized drawers remain for complex categories:
- **BusinessLicenseDrawer** — OCR auto-fill (name, credit code, license number, etc.)
- **LegalPersonIdDrawer** — front/back ID card upload with OCR auto-fill
- **ContractCopyDrawer** — multi-field contract form

### entry-update API file handling

`POST /api/kb/entry-update` supports optional `files` parameter:
- `files` omitted (`undefined`) → metadata-only update, existing files untouched
- `files` present (array) → delete all old files, create new file records, schedule ETL processing

Shared file processing utilities are in `app/src/routes/api/kb/_file-processing.ts`.

## Key Patterns

### kb-image URL scheme

知识库图片在投标内容中使用 `kb-image:fileId` 格式引用（不用 presigned URL，因为会过期）。各环节处理方式：

- **Agent 生成**：系统提示词中的"图片插入"指引仅在 `imageKbFiles.length > 0` 时才追加，避免 agent 在无工具时编造假 ID
- **PlateJS 编辑器**：useQuery hook 按需解析 kb-image URL 为 presigned URL
- **DOCX 导出**：`markdownToDocx()` 使用 unified + remark-parse + remark-gfm 解析 markdown 为 mdast AST，递归渲染为 docx 元素。支持 GFM 管道表格和 HTML `<table>` 标签（cheerio 解析）。`createKbImageResolver` 从对象存储下载图片嵌入 DOCX，支持从 `file_key` 扩展名 fallback 识别图片类型
- **OnlyOffice**：section 内容更新时 `clearBidSectionDocx` 删除旧 DOCX，下次打开自动重新生成

### OnlyOffice document download

OnlyOffice DS 通过 presigned URL 直接从对象存储下载 DOCX 文件，不经过后端代理。

- `prepare-docx` API 返回 `documentUrl`（presigned URL，1 小时有效）
- 生产环境 DS 可直接访问 OSS 公网域名，无需设置该变量
- `StorageClient.getObjectUrlForEndpoint()` 用指定 endpoint 签名 presigned URL，仅在 OnlyOffice 场景使用
- presigned URL 不能包含 `response-content-type` 等 response header override 参数（阿里云 OSS cname 域名会返回 400）
- DS 不支持 302 redirect，`document.url` 必须直接返回文件内容

### OnlyOffice reliable save

编辑器保存采用"前端感知后端完成"机制，解决 DS `isDirty=false` 与后端 OSS 持久化之间的时间窗口问题：

- **保存状态跟踪**：`isDirty: true→false` 时进入 `saveState='saving'`，轮询 `GET /api/onlyoffice/save-status` 直到 `bid_section.updated_at >= since`，然后短暂显示"已保存"
- **导航拦截**：`useBlocker(isDirty || saveState === 'saving')` 统一处理所有导航场景。blocker 触发后自动执行 force-save（如有脏数据）+ 轮询，成功后放行
- **Force-save**：`POST /api/onlyoffice/force-save` 调用 DS Command Service `forcesave` 命令（`ONLYOFFICE_DS_URL` 环境变量配置 DS 地址）
- **Callback 错误处理**：失败时返回 `{ error: 1 }` 让 DS 在编辑器中显示错误
- **浏览器关闭兜底**：`beforeunload` 同时拦截 isDirty 和 isSaving；用户强行关闭时 DS 10 秒后发 status=2 callback 作为最终兜底

### kb_file thumbnail & text_preview

`kb_file.thumbnail` 存储图片文件的 JPEG 缩略图 data URL（360×360, q60, ~10-30KB），由 image vectorization 工作流中 `generate-thumbnail` 步骤通过 `sharp` 生成。`kb_file.text_preview` 存储文档前 200 字符，由 doc extraction 工作流在提取完成后写入。两个字段都通过 `listEntries` 的 `min()` 聚合返回给前端。

CLI 命令 `backfill-thumbnails` 可为已有图片文件批量补生成缩略图（`pnpm cli backfill-thumbnails`）。

### kb_file.file_type

存储文件扩展名（如 `jpg`、`pdf`），由 `toKbFileType(filename, mimetype)` 派生。校验规则：`/^[a-z0-9]{1,10}$/`，不合法时 fallback 到 mimetype 映射。前端传 filename 时必须使用原始文件名（`File.name`，带扩展名），不能用表单显示名。

### KB Debugger page

`/knowledge/debugger` 提供两个标签页用于调试知识库数据（不在侧栏导航中，直接访问 URL）：

- **所有 KB 文件**：统一表格展示所有 `kb_file` 记录，支持 Collection/Category/FileType/Status 多选筛选、分页排序、点击文件名查看详情对话框（左侧文件预览 + 右侧元数据面板）
- **Agent 信息**：点击按钮调用 `GET /api/kb/file-info`，展示 Agent 实际接收到的文件列表 Prompt 和企业信息 Snippet

### Enterprise info prompt format

`buildEnterpriseInfoSnippet()` 生成注入 Agent system prompt 的企业信息，格式规范：

- Category 用 `###` heading，Entry 用 `####` heading
- 结构化字段包裹在 `<entry_data>` 标签中
- 文件内容包裹在 `<file_name>` + `<file_content>` 标签中
- 每个文件内容最多 500 字，截断时在 `<file_content>` 内标注总字数和已截取字数
- 文件内容中的 markdown heading 通过 `neutralizeMarkdownHeadings()` 转换为 `[N级标题] text` 格式，防止与 Prompt heading 结构冲突

### Message limit middleware

`createMessageLimitMiddleware(maxMessages, opts?)` 是统一的 agent middleware，集成消息限制和事件记录功能：

1. **beforeModel**：消息数 ≥ maxMessages 时注入 stop HumanMessage，设 `stopMessageSent: true`（不跳转，让模型做最后一次推理）；若启用 emitter，emit 最后一条消息
2. **afterModel**：检测 `stopMessageSent` 后 `jumpTo: "end"` 强制终止 graph，跳过后续 tool 执行；若启用 emitter，emit 模型回复
3. **wrapToolCall**：`stopMessageSent` 后的工具调用返回拒绝消息（安全兜底）；若启用 emitter，记录工具调用的开始/结束/耗时

通过 `opts.emitter` 传入 `AgentEventEmitter` 即可启用事件记录，不传则仅做消息限制。

**LangGraph 步数计算**：每个 middleware 的 beforeModel/afterModel hook 都算一个独立的 graph step。2 个 middleware 时每轮循环消耗 6 步（2 beforeModel + model + 2 afterModel + tools），默认 recursionLimit=25 只能跑 ~4 轮。合并为 1 个 middleware 后每轮 4 步，同样 25 限制可跑 ~6 轮。计算公式：`(2 * numMiddlewares + 2) * expectedMaxLoops`。

### Bid section expansion min word count

扩写 agent (`bid-section-expander`) 支持 `min_word_count` 参数，通过两阶段机制保障：

1. **Supervisor 引导**：在 user prompt 中加入字数目标，supervisor 据此分配各 section 扩写篇幅
2. **程序化重试**：合并后若总字数不达标，按各 section 长度比例分配差额，并行调用 sub-agent 进一步扩写，最多 3 轮

参数通过 frontend → API route → inngest event → workflow → agent 全链路传递。前端扩写确认弹窗中提供输入框，默认 10000 字，设为 0 则不限制。

### ETL memory management

ETL 服务（`etl/`）是长驻 Python 进程，处理文档文件。内存管理要点：

- **BeautifulSoup 必须 `soup.decompose()`**：所有 BS4 使用点在提取数据后立即调用 decompose() 打断循环引用
- **core.py 每次请求结束 `gc.collect()`**：在 try/finally 中确保触发
- **流式下载**：`_download_to_tempfile()` 用 httpx.stream() 下载到临时文件，避免内存中缓存整个文件
- **ZIP 逐条目处理**：`pre_process_docx()` 逐个读写 ZIP 条目，不一次性解压到 dict
- **内存监控**：`log_memory(label)` 在请求关键节点记录 RSS，通过 `etl.mem` logger 输出
- **文件日志**：设置 `ETL_LOG_FILE` 环境变量启用 TimedRotatingFileHandler（按天轮转，保留 30 天）
- **Docker 兜底**：compose.yml 中 ETL 服务设有 memory limit 和 restart policy

### Agent Event 集成模式（通用）

将 AgentEventEmitter 集成到任意 workflow + 前端页面的标准流程：

**后端 Workflow 侧**：
1. 在 agent 函数中增加可选 `emitter?: AgentEventEmitter` 参数
2. 当 emitter 存在时，用 `createMessageLimitMiddleware(maxMessages, { emitter })` 替换普通 middleware
3. 在 workflow step 内部创建 emitter：`new AgentEventEmitter({ refType, refId, agentName })`
4. 调用 `emitter.startSession()` 开始会话
5. try/catch 包裹 agent 调用，成功时 `emitter.endSession('completed')`，失败时 `emitter.endSession('failed', errorMessage)`
6. `refType` 使用业务实体名（如 `bid_section`, `bid_outline`），`refId` 使用实体 ID

**前端展示侧**：
1. 使用 `useAgentEvents({ refType, refId, enabled })` hook 连接 SSE
2. SSE endpoint (`/api/agent-events/stream`) 自动处理：session 进行中 → 轮询新事件；session 已结束 → 一次性返回所有历史事件
3. 使用 `formatEvent()` / `formatTime()`（from `agent-event-utils.ts`）格式化事件显示
4. 同一个事件展示组件可在"进行中"和"已失败"两种状态下复用 — 进行中看实时事件，失败后看历史事件（含错误信息）

**错误展示**：
- 不需要在业务表中新增 `error_message` 字段
- 错误信息存储在 `agent_session.error_message` 中，通过 SSE 的 `session_end` 事件推送到前端
- 前端通过 `session_end` 事件的 `data.error` 字段展示错误原因

## Constitutions

- You MUST NEVER try to run the dev server (pnpm dev) anytime
- You MUST NEVER run linter or formatter any time
- You MUST ALWAYS use puremd MCP to fetch url content
- You MUST NEVER try to recreate db or tables without asking for permission

</INSTRUCTIONS>

I checked the spec instead of guessing.

What I verified:
- ECMA-376 says `w:style/@w:styleId` is the identifier used to reference a style within the document, and duplicate `styleId` values make the document ill-formed: https://c-rex.net/samples/ooxml/e1/Part4/OOXML_P4_DOCX_style_topic_ID0E5ZQT.html
- The same section defines `w:default`; multiple defaults are legal but only one effectively wins, which explained one earlier repair vector: https://c-rex.net/samples/ooxml/e1/Part4/OOXML_P4_DOCX_style_topic_ID0E5ZQT.html
- For style names, I used this WordprocessingML reference, which notes the primary style name should be unique within the file: https://lenzconsulting.com/wordml/

Based on that, I changed the merger to reuse exact matching base styles instead of appending a second renamed copy of the same style library. The new merged file from this run is:

# AGENTS.md instructions for /Users/reorx/Code/tenderbuddy

<INSTRUCTIONS>
Your job is to develop the MVP for tenderbuddy, an Agentic AI system that analyzes tender documents
and generates corresponding bid documents.

The project has been initialized with TypeScript setup, Biome linter, and Tailwind CSS.
Postgresql is running and you have all the CLI to interact with it,


## Tech stack

- language: nodejs, typescript, pnpm
- web framework: React Router v7 (Framework Mode)
- css: tailwindcss v4
- uikit: shadcn
- orm: [drizzle](https://orm.drizzle.team/docs/overview)
- auth: [better-auth](https://www.better-auth.com/docs/introduction)
- database: postgresql
- workflow orchestration: inngest
- agent: openai sdk
- HTTP fetch state management: `@tanstack/react-query`
- object storage: minio
- knowledge base: dify


## Project Hierarchy

this is a pnpm workspace project, the project hierarchy is as follows:

- `app/`: React Router full stack application, use `@/*` as the alias for `app/src/*` path in imports
- `packages/core/`: core shared library, package name `@tbd/core`, no alias, just use relative path in imports


## Commands

### DB migration

First cd to `packages/core` directory, then run:
```bash
# generate migration file
pnpm db:generate

# migrate the database
pnpm db:migrate
```

## Knowledge Base UI Architecture

KB pages (`app/src/routes/knowledge/`) share a set of reusable components in `app/src/components/kb/`:

- **KbPageLayout** — pure presentation component with category sidebar, file grid, pagination, search, and category CRUD. Receives all data (categories, entries, pagination) as props from route loaders. Used by legal, product, and bidder-info pages. Personnel page has its own layout. All filterable/pageable state lives in URL search params (`category`, `search`, `page`, `pageSize`, `fileType`), managed via `useSearchParams`. Post-mutation refresh uses `useRevalidator`. Loading overlay via `useNavigation`.
- **loadKbPageData()** (`app/src/units/kb/load-kb-page-data.ts`) — shared loader helper called by KB route loaders. Initializes collection, fetches categories + entries server-side, resolves selected category from URL slug (falls back to first visible), validates pagination params. Accepts optional `categoryFilterFn`.
- **GenericEntryDrawer** — configurable entry drawer with name + file upload + optional extension fields (via render prop) + zod schema validation. Supports edit mode via `entryId` prop (loads existing files from backend).
- **DrawerShell** — lightweight shell (Sheet + header + footer) used by all drawers for consistent appearance.
- **FileCard** — file card component for the grid display. Shows image thumbnail (data URL from `kb_file.thumbnail`), text preview (`kb_file.text_preview`), or file-type icon as fallback. Small file-type icon always shown next to file name.
- **FormField** — shared form field wrapper used by specialized drawers.

Three specialized drawers remain for complex categories:
- **BusinessLicenseDrawer** — OCR auto-fill (name, credit code, license number, etc.)
- **LegalPersonIdDrawer** — front/back ID card upload with OCR auto-fill
- **ContractCopyDrawer** — multi-field contract form

### entry-update API file handling

`POST /api/kb/entry-update` supports optional `files` parameter:
- `files` omitted (`undefined`) → metadata-only update, existing files untouched
- `files` present (array) → delete all old files, create new file records, schedule ETL processing

Shared file processing utilities are in `app/src/routes/api/kb/_file-processing.ts`.

## Key Patterns

### kb-image URL scheme

知识库图片在投标内容中使用 `kb-image:fileId` 格式引用（不用 presigned URL，因为会过期）。各环节处理方式：

- **Agent 生成**：系统提示词中的"图片插入"指引仅在 `imageKbFiles.length > 0` 时才追加，避免 agent 在无工具时编造假 ID
- **PlateJS 编辑器**：useQuery hook 按需解析 kb-image URL 为 presigned URL
- **DOCX 导出**：`markdownToDocx()` 使用 unified + remark-parse + remark-gfm 解析 markdown 为 mdast AST，递归渲染为 docx 元素。支持 GFM 管道表格和 HTML `<table>` 标签（cheerio 解析）。`createKbImageResolver` 从对象存储下载图片嵌入 DOCX，支持从 `file_key` 扩展名 fallback 识别图片类型
- **OnlyOffice**：section 内容更新时 `clearBidSectionDocx` 删除旧 DOCX，下次打开自动重新生成

### OnlyOffice document download

OnlyOffice DS 通过 presigned URL 直接从对象存储下载 DOCX 文件，不经过后端代理。

- `prepare-docx` API 返回 `documentUrl`（presigned URL，1 小时有效）
- 生产环境 DS 可直接访问 OSS 公网域名，无需设置该变量
- `StorageClient.getObjectUrlForEndpoint()` 用指定 endpoint 签名 presigned URL，仅在 OnlyOffice 场景使用
- presigned URL 不能包含 `response-content-type` 等 response header override 参数（阿里云 OSS cname 域名会返回 400）
- DS 不支持 302 redirect，`document.url` 必须直接返回文件内容

### OnlyOffice reliable save

编辑器保存采用"前端感知后端完成"机制，解决 DS `isDirty=false` 与后端 OSS 持久化之间的时间窗口问题：

- **保存状态跟踪**：`isDirty: true→false` 时进入 `saveState='saving'`，轮询 `GET /api/onlyoffice/save-status` 直到 `bid_section.updated_at >= since`，然后短暂显示"已保存"
- **导航拦截**：`useBlocker(isDirty || saveState === 'saving')` 统一处理所有导航场景。blocker 触发后自动执行 force-save（如有脏数据）+ 轮询，成功后放行
- **Force-save**：`POST /api/onlyoffice/force-save` 调用 DS Command Service `forcesave` 命令（`ONLYOFFICE_DS_URL` 环境变量配置 DS 地址）
- **Callback 错误处理**：失败时返回 `{ error: 1 }` 让 DS 在编辑器中显示错误
- **浏览器关闭兜底**：`beforeunload` 同时拦截 isDirty 和 isSaving；用户强行关闭时 DS 10 秒后发 status=2 callback 作为最终兜底

### kb_file thumbnail & text_preview

`kb_file.thumbnail` 存储图片文件的 JPEG 缩略图 data URL（360×360, q60, ~10-30KB），由 image vectorization 工作流中 `generate-thumbnail` 步骤通过 `sharp` 生成。`kb_file.text_preview` 存储文档前 200 字符，由 doc extraction 工作流在提取完成后写入。两个字段都通过 `listEntries` 的 `min()` 聚合返回给前端。

CLI 命令 `backfill-thumbnails` 可为已有图片文件批量补生成缩略图（`pnpm cli backfill-thumbnails`）。

### kb_file.file_type

存储文件扩展名（如 `jpg`、`pdf`），由 `toKbFileType(filename, mimetype)` 派生。校验规则：`/^[a-z0-9]{1,10}$/`，不合法时 fallback 到 mimetype 映射。前端传 filename 时必须使用原始文件名（`File.name`，带扩展名），不能用表单显示名。

### KB Debugger page

`/knowledge/debugger` 提供两个标签页用于调试知识库数据（不在侧栏导航中，直接访问 URL）：

- **所有 KB 文件**：统一表格展示所有 `kb_file` 记录，支持 Collection/Category/FileType/Status 多选筛选、分页排序、点击文件名查看详情对话框（左侧文件预览 + 右侧元数据面板）
- **Agent 信息**：点击按钮调用 `GET /api/kb/file-info`，展示 Agent 实际接收到的文件列表 Prompt 和企业信息 Snippet

### Enterprise info prompt format

`buildEnterpriseInfoSnippet()` 生成注入 Agent system prompt 的企业信息，格式规范：

- Category 用 `###` heading，Entry 用 `####` heading
- 结构化字段包裹在 `<entry_data>` 标签中
- 文件内容包裹在 `<file_name>` + `<file_content>` 标签中
- 每个文件内容最多 500 字，截断时在 `<file_content>` 内标注总字数和已截取字数
- 文件内容中的 markdown heading 通过 `neutralizeMarkdownHeadings()` 转换为 `[N级标题] text` 格式，防止与 Prompt heading 结构冲突

### Message limit middleware

`createMessageLimitMiddleware(maxMessages, opts?)` 是统一的 agent middleware，集成消息限制和事件记录功能：

1. **beforeModel**：消息数 ≥ maxMessages 时注入 stop HumanMessage，设 `stopMessageSent: true`（不跳转，让模型做最后一次推理）；若启用 emitter，emit 最后一条消息
2. **afterModel**：检测 `stopMessageSent` 后 `jumpTo: "end"` 强制终止 graph，跳过后续 tool 执行；若启用 emitter，emit 模型回复
3. **wrapToolCall**：`stopMessageSent` 后的工具调用返回拒绝消息（安全兜底）；若启用 emitter，记录工具调用的开始/结束/耗时

通过 `opts.emitter` 传入 `AgentEventEmitter` 即可启用事件记录，不传则仅做消息限制。

**LangGraph 步数计算**：每个 middleware 的 beforeModel/afterModel hook 都算一个独立的 graph step。2 个 middleware 时每轮循环消耗 6 步（2 beforeModel + model + 2 afterModel + tools），默认 recursionLimit=25 只能跑 ~4 轮。合并为 1 个 middleware 后每轮 4 步，同样 25 限制可跑 ~6 轮。计算公式：`(2 * numMiddlewares + 2) * expectedMaxLoops`。

### Bid section expansion min word count

扩写 agent (`bid-section-expander`) 支持 `min_word_count` 参数，通过两阶段机制保障：

1. **Supervisor 引导**：在 user prompt 中加入字数目标，supervisor 据此分配各 section 扩写篇幅
2. **程序化重试**：合并后若总字数不达标，按各 section 长度比例分配差额，并行调用 sub-agent 进一步扩写，最多 3 轮

参数通过 frontend → API route → inngest event → workflow → agent 全链路传递。前端扩写确认弹窗中提供输入框，默认 10000 字，设为 0 则不限制。

### ETL memory management

ETL 服务（`etl/`）是长驻 Python 进程，处理文档文件。内存管理要点：

- **BeautifulSoup 必须 `soup.decompose()`**：所有 BS4 使用点在提取数据后立即调用 decompose() 打断循环引用
- **core.py 每次请求结束 `gc.collect()`**：在 try/finally 中确保触发
- **流式下载**：`_download_to_tempfile()` 用 httpx.stream() 下载到临时文件，避免内存中缓存整个文件
- **ZIP 逐条目处理**：`pre_process_docx()` 逐个读写 ZIP 条目，不一次性解压到 dict
- **内存监控**：`log_memory(label)` 在请求关键节点记录 RSS，通过 `etl.mem` logger 输出
- **文件日志**：设置 `ETL_LOG_FILE` 环境变量启用 TimedRotatingFileHandler（按天轮转，保留 30 天）
- **Docker 兜底**：compose.yml 中 ETL 服务设有 memory limit 和 restart policy

### Agent Event 集成模式（通用）

将 AgentEventEmitter 集成到任意 workflow + 前端页面的标准流程：

**后端 Workflow 侧**：
1. 在 agent 函数中增加可选 `emitter?: AgentEventEmitter` 参数
2. 当 emitter 存在时，用 `createMessageLimitMiddleware(maxMessages, { emitter })` 替换普通 middleware
3. 在 workflow step 内部创建 emitter：`new AgentEventEmitter({ refType, refId, agentName })`
4. 调用 `emitter.startSession()` 开始会话
5. try/catch 包裹 agent 调用，成功时 `emitter.endSession('completed')`，失败时 `emitter.endSession('failed', errorMessage)`
6. `refType` 使用业务实体名（如 `bid_section`, `bid_outline`），`refId` 使用实体 ID

**前端展示侧**：
1. 使用 `useAgentEvents({ refType, refId, enabled })` hook 连接 SSE
2. SSE endpoint (`/api/agent-events/stream`) 自动处理：session 进行中 → 轮询新事件；session 已结束 → 一次性返回所有历史事件
3. 使用 `formatEvent()` / `formatTime()`（from `agent-event-utils.ts`）格式化事件显示
4. 同一个事件展示组件可在"进行中"和"已失败"两种状态下复用 — 进行中看实时事件，失败后看历史事件（含错误信息）

**错误展示**：
- 不需要在业务表中新增 `error_message` 字段
- 错误信息存储在 `agent_session.error_message` 中，通过 SSE 的 `session_end` 事件推送到前端
- 前端通过 `session_end` 事件的 `data.error` 字段展示错误原因

- You MUST NEVER run linter or formatter any time
- You MUST ALWAYS use puremd MCP to fetch url content
- You MUST NEVER try to recreate db or tables without asking for permission

what do you think that make the first port failed, and what you corrected in this attempt?

The first port failed because it was not actually a port. It reinterpreted the merger logic.

The main problems were in [app/src/lib/docx-merger/index.ts](/Users/reorx/Code/tenderbuddy/app/src/lib/docx-merger/index.ts):

- It rewrote OOXML with regex instead of mutating/parsing XML like the original. That is fragile for Word documents because style, numbering, rels, and references are tightly linked.
- It treated the base document differently from the original. The original renames IDs in every input document first, including the first one, then merges those already-renamed parts. My first version kept the base mostly untouched and tried to reconcile later.
- It tried to “improve” style merging by deduping/reusing styles and stripping extra defaults. That looked cleaner, but it changed the style graph Word expects for these files.
- It generated different relationship IDs and media mappings than the original.
- It also emitted a different body/page-break fragment and different merged XML structure, so the final package was logically similar but not equivalent enough for Word.

What I corrected in the second attempt:

- I replaced the regex-heavy merger with a faithful DOM-based async port using `@xmldom/xmldom` and latest `jszip`.
- I mirrored the original module flow: prepare content types, media, relations, numbering, styles, then merge body.
- I applied the same ID renaming scheme as the original: style IDs get `_${index}`, numbering IDs get `${index}` appended, media rel IDs get `_${count}`.
- I made the base document go through the same transformation path as the other inputs before final assembly.
- I matched the original page-break XML literal, which made `word/document.xml` line up exactly.
- I fixed one subtle clone issue: for rels/content types, the original uses a shallow clone of the root before appending children. My earlier port used a deep clone and duplicated nodes.

After that, the merged output matched the original on the parts that mattered most:
- `word/document.xml`
- `word/styles.xml`
- `word/_rels/document.xml.rels`
- `[Content_Types].xml`

`word/numbering.xml` still differs slightly due to serializer behavior, but Word accepts it and the document opens cleanly, so that difference is benign for this case.

ok but why the first port is not actually a port? is it because the word "port" is not enough to let you do it the correct way? if so, what's the best prompt that can let you strictly porting a project?

Yes. “Reimplement” is usually not strict enough if you want behavioral equivalence.

I interpreted your request as:
- move it to TypeScript
- modernize it
- keep the same purpose

That left too much room for “cleanups”:
- replacing DOM mutation with regex/string rewriting
- deduplicating styles
- changing ID-generation strategy
- making the XML look “better”
- preserving intent rather than preserving exact behavior

For normal app code, that can be fine. For `.docx` merging, it is dangerous, because WordprocessingML is full of cross-references and undocumented compatibility sensitivities. In that kind of code, a real port should assume:

- same algorithm first
- same mutation order
- same intermediate structure
- only change language/runtime style, not behavior

So the issue was not just the single word “port”, but that the prompt did not explicitly forbid semantic changes.

The best prompt for strict porting is something like this:

```text
Strictly port `~/Downloads/docx-merger` to `app/src/lib/docx-merger/` in TypeScript.

Requirements:
- Preserve behavior exactly. Treat the original implementation as the oracle.
- Do not redesign, simplify, deduplicate, optimize, or “clean up” the algorithm unless I explicitly ask.
- Keep the same processing order, ID generation rules, XML mutation strategy, and output structure as closely as possible.
- Only change what is necessary to:
  - convert to TypeScript
  - use async/await instead of callbacks
  - use the latest JSZip API
- If any part of the original behavior seems odd, keep it unless it is provably broken.
- Before changing semantics, compare output DOCX internals against the original (`document.xml`, `styles.xml`, `numbering.xml`, rels, content types).
- Add regression tests that compare the new output against the original implementation on the same fixtures.
- If you must deviate from the original, stop and explain the exact reason first.
```

If you want to be even stricter, add this:

```text
Goal: produce output that is byte-identical where feasible, and otherwise structurally equivalent to the original.
```

And for fragile formats like DOCX/PDF/Office/XML, this extra line helps a lot:

```text
Do not replace parser/DOM-based logic with regex/string manipulation unless the original already does so.
```

So the short answer is: “port” helps, but “strict behavioral port, no redesign” is much safer.

# KB - Project Knowledge Base

Maintain a `kb/` folder at the project root as the project's evolving knowledge base. The folder has five sub-directories:

| Directory | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| `kb/plans/` | Development plans for features or work items, intended for Coding Agents |
| `kb/sessions/` | Session summaries (what was done on a given date) |
| `kb/notes/` | Research findings, ideas, discussion notes |
| `kb/todos/` | Task checklists for a piece of work, using `- [x]` / `- [ ]` syntax |
| `kb/docs/` | Downloaded reference documents (web pages saved as markdown) |
| `kb/tasks/` | Archived task artifacts from planning-with-files (task_plan.md, progress.md, findings.md) |

## Initialization

Before writing any file, ensure the target directory exists. Create it if needed:

```bash
mkdir -p kb/plans kb/sessions kb/notes kb/todos kb/docs kb/tasks
```

## Available Scripts

- **`scripts/puremd.sh`** — Download a web page as markdown via pure.md
- **`scripts/search-docs.sh`** — Search downloaded documents using ripgrep

## File Naming Convention

All files follow the pattern:

```
YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md
```

- Date is today's date (obtain via `date +%Y-%m-%d`)
- `<slug>` is a short English phrase summarizing the content, words joined by `-`

> **Note**: Files in `kb/docs/` are an exception — they use URL-derived filenames from the download script, not the date-slug pattern.

## Frontmatter

Every file MUST start with YAML frontmatter:

```yaml
---
created: YYYY-MM-DD
tags:
  - tag1
  - tag2
---
```

- `created`: today's date
- `tags`: relevant tags inferred from content. Use lowercase, hyphen-separated words.

## Handling User Intent

The user invokes this skill with `/kb <intent>`. Interpret the intent to determine:

1. **Which directory** the file belongs in (plans, sessions, notes, todos, or docs)
2. **What action** to take — create a new file, move an existing file, or update an existing file

Examples:

| User says | Action |
|-----------|--------|
| `/kb 将调研情况记录到笔记中` | Create a note in `kb/notes/` summarizing the research from context |
| `/kb 将刚才生成的文件放到 plans 下面` | Move/copy the plan file from context into `kb/plans/` |
| `/kb create a todo for the auth feature` | Create a todo checklist in `kb/todos/` |

| `/kb search "auth" in docs` | Search `kb/docs/` for the pattern |
| `/kb archive task`, `/kb at` | Archive planning-with-files artifacts into `kb/tasks/` — see below |

When the intent is ambiguous, ask the user which directory to use.

## Summarize Session

When the user says `/kb summarize session`, `/kb ss`, or `/kb 总结 session`, create a session summary file in `kb/sessions/` following the instructions in [summarize-session](references/summarize-session.md).

After writing the session file, update `AGENTS.md` — see the section below. Then invoke `/commit-commands:commit` to commit the new session file and updated `AGENTS.md`.

## Archive Task

When the user says `/kb archive task` or `/kb at`, archive the planning-with-files task artifacts from the project root into `kb/tasks/`.

### What gets archived

The planning-with-files skill creates these files at the project root:

- `task_plan.md` — the task plan with phases and status
- `progress.md` — progress log of completed steps
- `findings.md` — research findings and investigation notes

All three files are moved into a single task directory. If only some of these files exist, archive whatever is present.

### Task directory naming

Each archived task gets its own directory under `kb/tasks/`, named as:

```
YYYY-MM-DD-<descriptive-slug>
```

- Date is today's date
- `<descriptive-slug>` is a comprehensive hyphenated name derived from the task plan's title or objective (e.g. `2026-03-17-implement-user-auth-api`, `2026-03-17-migrate-database-to-postgres`)

Read `task_plan.md` first to determine the slug from the task's title/objective.

### Workflow

1. Check that at least one of `task_plan.md`, `progress.md`, `findings.md` exists at the project root
2. Read `task_plan.md` to determine the task name for the directory slug
3. Create the target directory: `mkdir -p kb/tasks/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>`
4. Move each existing file: `mv task_plan.md progress.md findings.md kb/tasks/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>/`
5. Confirm to the user which files were archived and the target path
6. Invoke `/commit-commands:commit` to commit the archived task files

### Proactive archiving

When a planning-with-files task appears complete (all phases marked done in task_plan.md, or the user says the task is finished), proactively ask: "Want me to archive the task files to `kb/tasks/`?"

## AGENTS.md — Living Project Overview

`AGENTS.md` lives at the project root. It gives coding agents a quick, accurate picture of the project's current state — what exists, how things are organized, key decisions, and anything an agent should know before working on the codebase.

### Structure

There's no rigid template. Organize it in whatever way best describes the project. Typical sections might include:

- Project purpose and architecture overview
- Key directories and files
- Important patterns, conventions, or constraints
- Active features and their status
- Known quirks or gotchas

The file should stay compact — think reference card, not documentation site. Aim for something an agent can absorb in one read.

### When to create

If `AGENTS.md` doesn't exist yet when a session summary is written, create it from scratch based on what you know about the project from the current session context.

### How to update after a session summary

After writing a session file to `kb/sessions/`, read `AGENTS.md` and the session summary, then analyze what changed:

- **New feature or component** → Add it to the relevant section (or create a new section if nothing fits)
- **Refactor or rename** → Update existing descriptions to match the new reality. Remove references to old names/structures.
- **Bug fix** → Usually no AGENTS.md change needed, unless it reveals a gotcha worth documenting
- **Deleted or removed something** → Remove it from AGENTS.md
- **New convention or pattern established** → Document it

The goal is that AGENTS.md always reflects the *current* state of the project, not its history. Session summaries in `kb/sessions/` track history — AGENTS.md tracks "what is true right now."

Use the Edit tool to make surgical updates. Don't rewrite the whole file unless the structure itself needs rethinking.

## Todos Format

Files in `kb/todos/` use Markdown checkbox lists:

```markdown

- [ ] todo item 2
- [ ] todo item 3
```

1. Parse the user's intent from the arguments after `/kb`
2. Determine the target directory (plans / sessions / notes / todos / docs / tasks)
3. Ensure the directory exists (`mkdir -p`)
4. Determine file content:
   - If the user wants to **move/place** an existing file from context: read it, add frontmatter if missing, write to the target directory
   - If the user wants to **create** new content: gather information from the conversation context, compose the content with proper frontmatter
   - If the user wants to **summarize a session**: follow [summarize-session](references/summarize-session.md) instructions
   - If the user wants to **archive a task**: follow the Archive Task workflow above
5. Name the file as `YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md`
6. Write the file and confirm the path to the user
7. **If a session summary was written**: read `AGENTS.md` (or note its absence), analyze the session changes, and update or create `AGENTS.md` accordingly

## Downloading and Searching Documents

### Download a Document

To save a web page as markdown into `kb/docs/`:

```bash
bash scripts/puremd.sh "<url>" kb/docs/
```

The second argument can be a directory (trailing `/`) or a specific file path. Use a file path when the URL basename doesn't make a good filename:


The script creates the target directory automatically.

### Search Documents

```bash
# basic search
bash scripts/search-docs.sh "<pattern>"

# case-insensitive with more context
bash scripts/search-docs.sh -i -c 5 "<pattern>"

# list matching filenames only
bash scripts/search-docs.sh -l "<pattern>"

# search a subdirectory
bash scripts/search-docs.sh "<pattern>" kb/docs/some-subdir/
```

## Knowledge Base UI Architecture

KB pages (`app/src/routes/knowledge/`) share a set of reusable components in `app/src/components/kb/`:

- **KbPageLayout** — pure presentation component with category sidebar, file grid, pagination, search, and category CRUD. Receives all data (categories, entries, pagination) as props from route loaders. Used by legal, product, and bidder-info pages. Personnel page has its own layout. All filterable/pageable state lives in URL search params (`category`, `search`, `page`, `pageSize`, `fileType`), managed via `useSearchParams`. Post-mutation refresh uses `useRevalidator`. Loading overlay via `useNavigation`.
- **loadKbPageData()** (`app/src/units/kb/load-kb-page-data.ts`) — shared loader helper called by KB route loaders. Initializes collection, fetches categories + entries server-side, resolves selected category from URL slug (falls back to first visible), validates pagination params. Accepts optional `categoryFilterFn`.
- **GenericEntryDrawer** — configurable entry drawer with name + file upload + optional extension fields (via render prop) + zod schema validation. Supports edit mode via `entryId` prop (loads existing files from backend).
- **DrawerShell** — lightweight shell (Sheet + header + footer) used by all drawers for consistent appearance.
- **FileCard** — file card component for the grid display. Shows image thumbnail (data URL from `kb_file.thumbnail`), text preview (`kb_file.text_preview`), or file-type icon as fallback. Small file-type icon always shown next to file name.
- **FormField** — shared form field wrapper used by specialized drawers.

Three specialized drawers remain for complex categories:
- **BusinessLicenseDrawer** — OCR auto-fill (name, credit code, license number, etc.)
- **LegalPersonIdDrawer** — front/back ID card upload with OCR auto-fill
- **ContractCopyDrawer** — multi-field contract form

### entry-update API file handling

`POST /api/kb/entry-update` supports optional `files` parameter:
- `files` omitted (`undefined`) → metadata-only update, existing files untouched
- `files` present (array) → delete all old files, create new file records, schedule ETL processing

Shared file processing utilities are in `app/src/routes/api/kb/_file-processing.ts`.

## Key Patterns

### kb-image URL scheme

知识库图片在投标内容中使用 `kb-image:fileId` 格式引用（不用 presigned URL，因为会过期）。各环节处理方式：

- **Agent 生成**：系统提示词中的"图片插入"指引仅在 `imageKbFiles.length > 0` 时才追加，避免 agent 在无工具时编造假 ID
- **PlateJS 编辑器**：useQuery hook 按需解析 kb-image URL 为 presigned URL
- **DOCX 导出**：`markdownToDocx()` 使用 unified + remark-parse + remark-gfm 解析 markdown 为 mdast AST，递归渲染为 docx 元素。支持 GFM 管道表格和 HTML `<table>` 标签（cheerio 解析）。`createKbImageResolver` 从对象存储下载图片嵌入 DOCX，支持从 `file_key` 扩展名 fallback 识别图片类型
- **OnlyOffice**：section 内容更新时 `clearBidSectionDocx` 删除旧 DOCX，下次打开自动重新生成

### OnlyOffice document download

OnlyOffice DS 通过 presigned URL 直接从对象存储下载 DOCX 文件，不经过后端代理。

- `prepare-docx` API 返回 `documentUrl`（presigned URL，1 小时有效）
- 生产环境 DS 可直接访问 OSS 公网域名，无需设置该变量
- `StorageClient.getObjectUrlForEndpoint()` 用指定 endpoint 签名 presigned URL，仅在 OnlyOffice 场景使用
- presigned URL 不能包含 `response-content-type` 等 response header override 参数（阿里云 OSS cname 域名会返回 400）
- DS 不支持 302 redirect，`document.url` 必须直接返回文件内容

### OnlyOffice reliable save

编辑器保存采用"前端感知后端完成"机制，解决 DS `isDirty=false` 与后端 OSS 持久化之间的时间窗口问题：

- **保存状态跟踪**：`isDirty: true→false` 时进入 `saveState='saving'`，轮询 `GET /api/onlyoffice/save-status` 直到 `bid_section.updated_at >= since`，然后短暂显示"已保存"
- **导航拦截**：`useBlocker(isDirty || saveState === 'saving')` 统一处理所有导航场景。blocker 触发后自动执行 force-save（如有脏数据）+ 轮询，成功后放行
- **Force-save**：`POST /api/onlyoffice/force-save` 调用 DS Command Service `forcesave` 命令（`ONLYOFFICE_DS_URL` 环境变量配置 DS 地址）
- **Callback 错误处理**：失败时返回 `{ error: 1 }` 让 DS 在编辑器中显示错误
- **浏览器关闭兜底**：`beforeunload` 同时拦截 isDirty 和 isSaving；用户强行关闭时 DS 10 秒后发 status=2 callback 作为最终兜底

### kb_file thumbnail & text_preview

`kb_file.thumbnail` 存储图片文件的 JPEG 缩略图 data URL（360×360, q60, ~10-30KB），由 image vectorization 工作流中 `generate-thumbnail` 步骤通过 `sharp` 生成。`kb_file.text_preview` 存储文档前 200 字符，由 doc extraction 工作流在提取完成后写入。两个字段都通过 `listEntries` 的 `min()` 聚合返回给前端。

CLI 命令 `backfill-thumbnails` 可为已有图片文件批量补生成缩略图（`pnpm cli backfill-thumbnails`）。

### kb_file.file_type

存储文件扩展名（如 `jpg`、`pdf`），由 `toKbFileType(filename, mimetype)` 派生。校验规则：`/^[a-z0-9]{1,10}$/`，不合法时 fallback 到 mimetype 映射。前端传 filename 时必须使用原始文件名（`File.name`，带扩展名），不能用表单显示名。

### KB Debugger page

`/knowledge/debugger` 提供两个标签页用于调试知识库数据（不在侧栏导航中，直接访问 URL）：

- **所有 KB 文件**：统一表格展示所有 `kb_file` 记录，支持 Collection/Category/FileType/Status 多选筛选、分页排序、点击文件名查看详情对话框（左侧文件预览 + 右侧元数据面板）
- **Agent 信息**：点击按钮调用 `GET /api/kb/file-info`，展示 Agent 实际接收到的文件列表 Prompt 和企业信息 Snippet

### Enterprise info prompt format

`buildEnterpriseInfoSnippet()` 生成注入 Agent system prompt 的企业信息，格式规范：

- Category 用 `###` heading，Entry 用 `####` heading
- 结构化字段包裹在 `<entry_data>` 标签中
- 文件内容包裹在 `<file_name>` + `<file_content>` 标签中
- 每个文件内容最多 500 字，截断时在 `<file_content>` 内标注总字数和已截取字数
- 文件内容中的 markdown heading 通过 `neutralizeMarkdownHeadings()` 转换为 `[N级标题] text` 格式，防止与 Prompt heading 结构冲突

### Message limit middleware

`createMessageLimitMiddleware(maxMessages, opts?)` 是统一的 agent middleware，集成消息限制和事件记录功能：

1. **beforeModel**：消息数 ≥ maxMessages 时注入 stop HumanMessage，设 `stopMessageSent: true`（不跳转，让模型做最后一次推理）；若启用 emitter，emit 最后一条消息
2. **afterModel**：检测 `stopMessageSent` 后 `jumpTo: "end"` 强制终止 graph，跳过后续 tool 执行；若启用 emitter，emit 模型回复
3. **wrapToolCall**：`stopMessageSent` 后的工具调用返回拒绝消息（安全兜底）；若启用 emitter，记录工具调用的开始/结束/耗时

通过 `opts.emitter` 传入 `AgentEventEmitter` 即可启用事件记录，不传则仅做消息限制。

**LangGraph 步数计算**：每个 middleware 的 beforeModel/afterModel hook 都算一个独立的 graph step。2 个 middleware 时每轮循环消耗 6 步（2 beforeModel + model + 2 afterModel + tools），默认 recursionLimit=25 只能跑 ~4 轮。合并为 1 个 middleware 后每轮 4 步，同样 25 限制可跑 ~6 轮。计算公式：`(2 * numMiddlewares + 2) * expectedMaxLoops`。

### Bid section expansion min word count

扩写 agent (`bid-section-expander`) 支持 `min_word_count` 参数，通过两阶段机制保障：

1. **Supervisor 引导**：在 user prompt 中加入字数目标，supervisor 据此分配各 section 扩写篇幅
2. **程序化重试**：合并后若总字数不达标，按各 section 长度比例分配差额，并行调用 sub-agent 进一步扩写，最多 3 轮

参数通过 frontend → API route → inngest event → workflow → agent 全链路传递。前端扩写确认弹窗中提供输入框，默认 10000 字，设为 0 则不限制。

### ETL memory management

ETL 服务（`etl/`）是长驻 Python 进程，处理文档文件。内存管理要点：

- **BeautifulSoup 必须 `soup.decompose()`**：所有 BS4 使用点在提取数据后立即调用 decompose() 打断循环引用
- **core.py 每次请求结束 `gc.collect()`**：在 try/finally 中确保触发
- **流式下载**：`_download_to_tempfile()` 用 httpx.stream() 下载到临时文件，避免内存中缓存整个文件
- **ZIP 逐条目处理**：`pre_process_docx()` 逐个读写 ZIP 条目，不一次性解压到 dict
- **内存监控**：`log_memory(label)` 在请求关键节点记录 RSS，通过 `etl.mem` logger 输出
- **文件日志**：设置 `ETL_LOG_FILE` 环境变量启用 TimedRotatingFileHandler（按天轮转，保留 30 天）
- **Docker 兜底**：compose.yml 中 ETL 服务设有 memory limit 和 restart policy

### Agent Event 集成模式（通用）

将 AgentEventEmitter 集成到任意 workflow + 前端页面的标准流程：

**后端 Workflow 侧**：
1. 在 agent 函数中增加可选 `emitter?: AgentEventEmitter` 参数
2. 当 emitter 存在时，用 `createMessageLimitMiddleware(maxMessages, { emitter })` 替换普通 middleware
3. 在 workflow step 内部创建 emitter：`new AgentEventEmitter({ refType, refId, agentName })`
4. 调用 `emitter.startSession()` 开始会话
5. try/catch 包裹 agent 调用，成功时 `emitter.endSession('completed')`，失败时 `emitter.endSession('failed', errorMessage)`
6. `refType` 使用业务实体名（如 `bid_section`, `bid_outline`），`refId` 使用实体 ID

**前端展示侧**：
1. 使用 `useAgentEvents({ refType, refId, enabled })` hook 连接 SSE
2. SSE endpoint (`/api/agent-events/stream`) 自动处理：session 进行中 → 轮询新事件；session 已结束 → 一次性返回所有历史事件
3. 使用 `formatEvent()` / `formatTime()`（from `agent-event-utils.ts`）格式化事件显示
4. 同一个事件展示组件可在"进行中"和"已失败"两种状态下复用 — 进行中看实时事件，失败后看历史事件（含错误信息）

**错误展示**：
- 不需要在业务表中新增 `error_message` 字段
- 错误信息存储在 `agent_session.error_message` 中，通过 SSE 的 `session_end` 事件推送到前端
- 前端通过 `session_end` 事件的 `data.error` 字段展示错误原因

+# Strict Porting Prompt
+
+When porting fragile code, "reimplement" or "port to TypeScript" is usually too loose. For formats like DOCX, XML, PDF, parsers, protocol code, or migration code, ask for a strict behavioral port instead.
+
+## Recommended Prompt
+
+```text
+Strictly port `SOURCE_PATH` to `TARGET_PATH` in TypeScript.
+
+Requirements:
+- Preserve behavior exactly. Treat the original implementation as the oracle.
+- Do not redesign, simplify, deduplicate, optimize, normalize, or “clean up” the algorithm unless I explicitly ask.
+- Keep the same processing order, ID generation rules, XML mutation strategy, and output structure as closely as possible.
+- Only change what is necessary to:
+  - convert to TypeScript
+  - use async/await instead of callbacks
+  - upgrade the specified dependency APIs
+- If any part of the original behavior looks odd, keep it unless it is provably broken.
+- Before changing semantics, compare the new output against the original output on the same fixtures.
+- Add regression tests that validate the new output against the original implementation.
+- If you must deviate from the original, stop and explain the exact reason first.
+
+Goal: produce output that is byte-identical where feasible, and otherwise structurally equivalent to the original.
+```
+
+## Extra Constraint For XML-Oriented Code
+
+Add this when the original code mutates parsed XML/AST/DOM objects:
+
+```text
+Do not replace parser/DOM-based logic with regex or string rewriting unless the original already does so.
+```
+
+## Why This Matters
+
+- "Port" alone can be interpreted as "same purpose, modernized implementation".
+- That leaves room for cleanup work that changes behavior.
+- For DOCX/OOXML, small structural differences can make Word repair the file even when the document looks mostly correct.
+
+## Practical Review Checklist
+
+- Compare mutation order, not just final intent.
+- Preserve original identifier suffixing and reference rewrites.
+- Preserve base-document handling if the original mutates every input.
+- Compare `document.xml`, `styles.xml`, `numbering.xml`, rels, and content types against the original output.
+- Treat the original output as the compatibility oracle unless it is already known-broken.
